language.name: English
app.title: CoWorker
app.subtitle: Ask a coding question or request a focused change in the current workspace.
runtime.connecting_body: CoWorker is starting up. Please wait. If this takes too long, try reopening the app.
runtime.error_body: Unable to connect to the local service. Please make sure CoWorker is running, or wait for the automatic retry.
titlebar.context_trim_hint: Old messages are auto-condensed near the limit to leave room for replies
titlebar.context_calibration: Calibrated ×{factor} (learned from this model's real usage)
titlebar.context_output_reserved: Output reserve: {tokens} tokens set aside for replies
chat.backend_unreachable: Could not connect to the local CoWorker service. Please restart CoWorker.
chat.model_unreachable_switch: Please switch to a reachable LLM model and try again.
chat.work_plan_tip: Plan mode: read-only research, ask for intent, produce a plan for approval
chat.work_build_tip: Build mode: work autonomously within the workspace, ask per autonomy
chat.autonomy_guarded_tip: Work freely inside the workspace, ask only at the boundary
chat.autonomy_autonomous_tip: Work fully autonomously, never ask the user
chat.stopped: Stopped waiting for this reply. If the service already began processing, its result will be ignored.
chat.stream_interrupted: Connection interrupted; the reply may be incomplete. You can regenerate it.
chat.command_help_text: Available commands: /help shows help, /new starts a new chat, /clear clears the chat, /providers opens providers, /settings opens settings.
chat.web_setup_hint_disabled: Web access is off. Enable it so the agent can search the web.
chat.web_setup_hint_no_key: Web search needs a Tavily API key.
chat.command_approval_waiting: Command approval is pending. Approve or reject it in Settings > Tool Audit.
chat.mcp_approval_destructive: The server marked this tool as destructive; it may make irreversible changes.
theme.preset_mineral_desc: Cool mineral blue-gray for long coding sessions.
theme.preset_hermes_desc: Leather, paper, and warm copper studio tones.
theme.preset_ember_desc: Low-light ember colors for action-heavy work.
theme.preset_sage_desc: Soft green tones that reduce interface fatigue.
theme.preset_graphite_desc: High-contrast grayscale with a terminal-tool feel.
theme.preset_azure_desc: VS Code classic blue — familiar, focused editor feel.
theme.preset_nocturne_desc: One Dark inspired — deep blue-violet, easy on the eyes.
theme.preset_solarized_desc: Solarized dual-mode — carefully balanced light & dark.
theme.preset_violet_desc: Violet with cool neutral greys — from the custom palette.
settings.title: Settings
settings.heading: Application Settings
settings.description: Manage interface preferences, theme, and chat defaults in one place.
settings.interface_group_desc: Control CoWorker's display language and visual theme.
settings.theme_desc: Choose light, dark, or the system appearance.
settings.appearance_desc: Control light, dark, or system appearance.
settings.palette_entry_desc: Open a second-level page to choose a theme style.
settings.translucent_theme_desc: Adds a translucent frosted material across the interface, similar to Apple glass panels.
shortcuts.group_desc: Customize key bindings, and restore defaults any time.
shortcuts.toggle_work_mode_desc: Switch between Plan and Build, like the composer toggle.
shortcuts.recording: Press a new combination… (Esc to cancel)
shortcuts.conflict: Conflicts with "{name}". Please choose another combination.
shortcuts.send_message_desc: Interject into the running task; sends normally when idle.
shortcuts.stop_agent_desc: Press Esc twice to stop the running agent.
shortcuts.toggle_sidebar_desc: Show or hide the workspace sidebar.
shortcuts.toggle_right_panel_desc: Show or hide the browser right panel.
shortcuts.toggle_bottom_panel_desc: Open or close the bottom panel (terminal).
shortcuts.attach_file_desc: Attach a file to the message.
shortcuts.view_providers_desc: Switch to the model providers view.
shortcuts.view_mcp_desc: Switch to the MCP servers view.
shortcuts.view_chat_desc: Press Esc to return to the chat view.
settings.shortcuts_entry_desc: View and customize global keyboard shortcuts.
settings.composer_group_desc: These defaults stay synchronized with the composer controls.
settings.work_mode_desc: Plan is for reasoning first; Build is for implementation work.
settings.agent_group_desc: Configure the AI agent’s autonomy level.
settings.runtime_group_desc: Control attachments, memory, and runtime limits.
settings.autonomy_desc: Confirm-each asks before every action; Guarded works freely inside the workspace and asks only at the boundary; Autonomous never asks.
settings.revert_code_desc: Clicking edit reverts immediately; cancelling restores the files.
settings.goal_enabled_desc: Let /goal create a persistent multi-round goal the agent keeps working toward.
settings.attachment_group_desc: Control the size limit for attachments sent with a message.
settings.max_attachment_mb_desc: Attachments larger than this are not inlined (only metadata is kept; the model decides whether to use them). Default 25 MB, customizable 1–1024 MB.
settings.audit_group_desc: Pending approvals across all sessions, plus runtime logs and record management.
settings.audit_entry_desc: Review cross-session to-dos, runtime logs, and record management.
settings.audit_pending_desc: These items come from different sessions — handle them here even when you are not in that session.
settings.audit_clear_confirm: Clear all audit records? This cannot be undone.
settings.retention_audit_desc: Records beyond this limit are cleaned up automatically to keep the file from growing unboundedly.
settings.log_clear_confirm: Clear the log file? This cannot be undone.
settings.web_group_desc: Web search and page fetching for the agent.
settings.web_entry_desc: Configure web search and page fetching for the agent.
settings.web_description: Web search and page fetching configuration.
settings.web_enabled_desc: Let the agent search the web and fetch pages.
settings.web_api_key_desc: Stored securely in the OS keychain. Leave empty to keep the current key.
settings.web_max_results_desc: Number of search results the agent receives by default (1–20).
settings.web_fetch_enabled_desc: Allow the agent to fetch and read full web pages.
settings.memory_group_desc: Long-term memory settings. Edits here apply to every workspace.
settings.memory_enabled_desc: Inject memory entries into every conversation.
settings.memory_auto_extract_desc: When enabled, the agent autonomously curates long-term memory: auto-extract plus consolidation after sessions end.
providers.title: Provider Management
providers.heading: AI Provider Management
providers.description: Configure AI providers for CoWorker's model calls.
providers.default_model_desc: Select which provider and model CoWorker should use.
providers.quick_add_desc: Select a template to pre-fill provider details.
providers.name: Name
providers.api_key_saved: Saved key will be kept if left blank.
providers.fetch_models_hint: Click the refresh button to fetch available models from this provider.
providers.delete_confirm: Deleting this provider will remove it permanently.
providers.empty_hint: Click a template above to add one quickly.
error.fetch_failed: A network request failed. Please try again, or restart CoWorker if the problem persists.
error.connection_refused: Could not connect to the local service. Please try restarting CoWorker.
error.electron_api_unavailable: The app did not start properly. Please reopen CoWorker from the desktop launcher.
error.skill_delete_not_in_root: Cannot delete this skill: its location ('{path}') is outside the recognized skill directories. Please remove it from the application's own settings or delete the symlink manually.
error.skill_delete_no_skill_md: Cannot delete: SKILL.md not found in the skill directory.
error.skill_fetch_empty: Failed to fetch skill file (downloaded content is empty).
error.context_overflow: Context window overflow — the conversation exceeded the model's token limit. The system attempted to auto-compact; please try again.
error.agent_timeout: The agent operation timed out. The task took longer than the maximum allowed duration.
error.agent_cancelled: The agent execution was cancelled mid-stream.
error.agent_stalled: The agent has stalled and could not make further progress. Please refine your request or try a different approach.
error.provider_error: The AI provider returned an error. Please check your provider configuration and try again.
chat.idle_warning: Stream has been idle for 4+ minutes — disconnecting in {seconds}s. Stay on this page to keep waiting.
inspector.title: Context
bottom_panel.command_placeholder: Run a workspace command; first run requires Settings approval
right_panel.logs_body: Logs panel is not available here yet.
browser.menu.agent_explain_element: Ask agent to explain this element
browser.menu.agent_annotate_element: Annotate a change and send to agent
browser.menu.agent_explain_page: Ask agent to explain this page
sidebar.project_has_pending: Has sessions processing or awaiting action
sidebar.project_delete_confirm: Deleting the project will also delete all of its sessions. Continue?
project_dialog.title: Create Project
project_dialog.description: Choose a local folder as CoWorker's actual working directory.
project_dialog.pick_workspace: Choose or create a project folder
project_dialog.workspace_hint: The agent will read, edit, and run commands in this folder: {path}
project_dialog.mode_single_desc: A single default agent for traditional conversational projects, no team features.
project_dialog.mode_multi_desc: Create teams and departments; agents can delegate tasks to each other. The mode cannot be changed after creation.
project_dialog.mode_taken: A project in {mode} mode already exists in this folder. Delete it and recreate, or choose another mode
new_chat.title: What can I help you with today?
new_chat.subtitle_workspace: Start a conversation in the {name} workspace
new_chat.subtitle_empty: Pick a workspace first, then start the conversation
first_run.title: Create a project before CoWorker starts working
first_run.description: The project workspace decides where the agent reads, edits, and runs commands. Choose a folder first, then every new session belongs to that project.
first_run.chat_project_hint: You can also start chatting right away — no project needed. CoWorker ships with a built-in “Chat” project (pinned at the top of the sidebar), isolated in its own sandbox folder.
chat_project.name: Chat
empty_project.title: {name} has no sessions yet
empty_project.description: This project is bound to a workspace. Once you start the first task, the session will appear under the project.
edit.revert_conflicts: Edit reverted {reverted} file change(s); {conflicts} conflicted with other sessions/manual edits and were skipped.
edit.redo_conflicts: Restored {restored} change(s); {conflicts} file(s) were hand-edited and skipped.
changes.title: Changes
changes.no_git: This workspace is not a Git repository; showing session changes only.

mcp.env_desc: Key-value environment variables to inject (e.g. API keys).

mcp.delete_confirm: Deleting this server will remove it permanently.
mcp.no_tools: No tools discovered yet (test connection to discover).
mcp.catalog_desc: Browse all available MCP services. Select a service to pre-configure it.
mcp.headers_desc: Common for remote server auth (e.g. Authorization: Bearer xxx).

mcp.tpl.git.name: Git
mcp.tpl.git.desc: Commit history, diffs, blame, and branch management
mcp.tpl.context7.name: Context7
mcp.tpl.context7.desc: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries
mcp.tpl.deepwiki.name: DeepWiki
mcp.tpl.deepwiki.desc: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository
mcp.tpl.sequential-thinking.name: Sequential Thinking

mcp.tpl.memory-server.desc: Knowledge graph memory for persistent context
mcp.tpl.playwright.name: Playwright

mcp.tpl.everything-server.desc: Official reference server exercising the full MCP spec
skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Reusable instruction packs (Agent Skills) loaded on demand
skills.empty: No skills found. Create SKILL.md under .coworker/skills or .agents/skills.
skills.validate_placeholder: Enter a skill directory or SKILL.md path
skills.slash_usage: Usage: /skill <name> [task]. e.g. /skill git-release create a 1.2.0 release.
skills.slash_loaded: Skill loaded: {name}. Follow the instructions below strictly:
skills.custom_create_desc: Create a custom skill from a template
skills.delete_confirm: Delete skill '{name}'? This removes all of its files and cannot be undone.
skills.open_file_hint: Open SKILL.md in the editor to view the full content
skills.market_source_unavailable: Skill source "{source}" is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.
memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Persistent notes the agent remembers across sessions: project preferences, conventions, and user facts. Edits here are injected into every chat.
memory.add_placeholder: e.g. The team deploys to staging on Fridays.
memory.export_desc: Save a zip archive to your computer
memory.import_unsupported: Zip import is only available in the desktop app
memory.import_conflict_desc: These files already exist. Decide per file to keep or overwrite.
memory.reveal_unsupported: Open in folder is only available in the desktop app
memory.editor_hint: Plain Markdown; entries are separated by blank lines.
memory.add_content_placeholder: File content — will be copied into the memory library
update.auto_update_desc: Silently check for updates on launch and every 30 minutes. Download the update in the background and notify you when it's ready to restart.
update.check_now_desc: Check right now whether a newer version is available.
update.idle_hint: No update check has run yet. Use “Check for updates” to check now.
update.error_unknown: Something went wrong while checking for updates.
update.error_unreachable: Cannot reach the GitHub update source (repo not public or network unreachable).
update.dev_mode: Updates are disabled in development mode.
memory.tree.no_projects: No project memory yet. It is created automatically when you start a project chat.
settings.org_group_desc: Manage the project's multi-agent team, department groups, and collaboration settings.
settings.org_entry_desc: Create/edit members, departments, and configure single/multi mode and collaboration limits.
settings.org_delete_agent_confirm: Delete this member? All of their sessions and memory directory will be removed (memory moves to the Trash).
settings.org_delete_team_confirm: Delete this department? (Only empty departments can be removed)
settings.org_default_agent_protected: default_agent is the project's main agent and cannot be deleted
providers.context_unreachable: LLM service unreachable; context window not detected
providers.context_discover_failed: Could not discover the context window from this provider
providers.ollama_ctx_hint: Ollama picks context by VRAM (4k–256k) by default and its OpenAI-compatible endpoint does not accept per-request num_ctx. To enlarge it, set PARAMETER num_ctx in a Modelfile, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH, or the app slider.
providers.max_output_tokens_hint: Caps a single generation to prevent runaway/repetitive output; a custom value must not exceed the model's real output limit
settings.log_level_hint: Applies immediately. Lower level = more detail.
settings.log_level_debug_hint: Switched to DEBUG — expect significantly more log output.
settings.sound_enabled_desc: Play audio cues for chat events like replies, errors, and approval requests.
chat.interject_queued_disabled: Interject now (only while a task is running)
chat.goal_help_text: Usage: /goal <description>. Sets a persistent goal the agent works toward autonomously until achieved. Include verifiable completion criteria.
chat.goal_stalled_hint: Agent stalled after multiple attempts. Consider pausing or editing the goal.
chat.goal_stopped_hint: Goal stopped. You can delete it or start a new goal.
goal.need_session: Start a conversation first (send a message), then set a goal.
goal.need_workspace: Select a workspace first, then set a goal.
goal.disabled: Goal capability is disabled. Enable it in Settings to use /goal.
chat.question_empty_fallback: The agent needs your input to continue — please reply with guidance.

dashboard.preview_font: Font files cannot be previewed here. Open them in a font application.
